4.name: Groom

effects.text: When played, play a horse from discard pile.
Choose a horse with 0-3 production. Spend {coin}{coin} to add any 1 resource sticker to it.

4.text: {triggeredOptional} When played, play a horse from discard pile. {activated} Choose a horse with 0-3 production. Spend {coin}{coin} to add any 1 resource sticker to it.
4.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: Previous versions didn't play horses automatically, and the groom couldn't add as many stickers to them.
This card has two Activated Effects. You cannot use more than 1 of them at the same time. Note that any kind of sticker counts on the horses, not just production stickers. Note also that the horse you add stickers to is not discarded when you do so, it can still be used later this turn to produce according to its newly developed skills.

description:
VERSION NOTE: The Groom has been buffed significantly since the first printing.
This is a card made accessible by the Stone Street, stage 3 of the Mason. It will let you discover 3 horses, and on stage 4 the Groom will improve them and train them to do your bidding.
